notes: BETA 2.29.94 - fixes found by a full code review of 2.29.93. Damage calls: an engine failure (F1 blown/seized engine, AMS2 over-rev) is no longer treated as a crash - you get an engine report instead of a crash roast, and one incident no longer gets two reactions. Race end: lapped cars in iRacing/ACC no longer finish a lap early, and lead-lap drivers no longer hear 'last lap' twice. iRacing: rejoining the same online race after a disconnect no longer wipes your laps or repeats the start brief. AMS2: P3/P4 prototypes are no longer called faster than GT3 before pace is measured. Corner tips no longer repeat the same advice every lap. 'Go go go' after switching from iRacing/LMU to AC/ACC works again. AI: Gemini Pro/thinking models get enough tokens to answer, the OpenAI 'no credit' message only shows for OpenAI (a Gemini rate limit no longer blocks your key for 10 minutes), custom endpoints like Groq get the right /v1 URL, and typing a voice name no longer overwrites the ElevenLabs voice. Korean without a local voice tells you honestly when the cloud voice fails. Everything from 2.29.93 is included (Edge voice fix, crash and damage calls, race end on your own line, Korean, custom AI endpoint). Not tested with the real games yet - please report on Discord.
